notes: USB and Ethernet are standard; IEEE-488.2 (option 1, address 0-31) and RS-232 (option 2) are factory options, and the front-panel Setup > Interface menu selects the active interface.

USB needs a virtual COM port driver (from Cryomagnetics or FTDI). The unit's baud rate (9600 by default, up to 115200) must match the port, every command is echoed back over USB before the reply, and command lines are limited to 120 characters on USB and Ethernet.

Sensor setup and calibration can only be done from the front panel. pylablib switches the unit into remote mode on connect, which disables the front-panel controls; pressing Local returns control to the panel and the unit then ignores remote commands.
Cryomagnetics' product page lists LabVIEW drivers for the LM-510. qcodes_contrib_drivers has a Cryomagnetics LM_500 driver, documented for the LM-500 only.

experiments.title: Acoustoelectric effect
experiments.summary: A surface acoustic wave drags carriers along and builds up a DC voltage (or current) in a conductor on its path. Its size follows the attenuation, so it tracks conductivity, quantum Hall states and magnetic order without contacts in the acoustic path.

rf.does: Drives the IDT at its resonance.

voltmeter.does: Reads the acoustoelectric voltage along the sample (or a diode detector at the second IDT).

plans: Frequency scan over the IDT resonance
Field sweep at the resonance

experiments.title: Surface acoustic wave transmission and magnetoacoustics
experiments.summary: Launch a surface acoustic wave with one interdigital transducer (IDT) and detect it with another: the change in amplitude and velocity against field, temperature or gate probes the conductivity of a 2D layer, magnetoelastic coupling and acoustically driven spin resonance.

vna.does: Measures S21 between the two IDTs, with time-domain gating.

gate.does: Tunes the carrier density of a 2D layer on the delay line.

experiments.title: AOM diffraction efficiency
experiments.summary: Measure the first-order diffracted power against RF power and frequency: the drive level for maximum efficiency, the linear range for amplitude control, and the bandwidth for frequency scans or double-pass setups.

power_meter.does: Measures the power in the first order.

plans: Efficiency against RF power at 80 MHz
Frequency response at 25 dBm

experiments.title: Photoluminescence excitation (PLE) wavelength scan
experiments.summary: Tune the excitation laser and record the emission: absorption resonances, excited states and the energy transfer that feeds an emitter (defects, quantum dots, rare-earth ions, excitons).

laser.does: A tunable CW laser (or the controller of a tunable diode laser).

counter.does: Counts the emission through a filter that blocks the laser.

plans: Scan from 730 nm to 740 nm in 0.01 nm steps

experiments.title: Cooldown log
experiments.summary: Record every thermometer (and a sample reading) through a cooldown, so this cooldown can be compared with the last: a slow stage means poor thermal contact, a leak or a blocked line, and the sample's resistance shows transitions on the way down.

lockin.does: Reads the sample's resistance at the same time.

plans: Every 30 s for 12 h

experiments.title: AC susceptibility with a lock-in
experiments.summary: A primary coil drives a small AC field; a pair of counter-wound pickup coils, one around the sample, reads the induced voltage. The in-phase and out-of-phase parts give χ' and χ'': superconducting transitions, magnetic order, spin-glass freezing.

lockin.does: Drives the primary coil and reads the pickup voltage.

plans: χ' and χ'' from 4 K to 20 K
Third harmonic through the same range

experiments.title: SQUID magnetometry (M-T and M-H)
experiments.summary: Magnetization against temperature (zero-field-cooled and field-cooled) and against field (hysteresis loops) in a SQUID or VSM magnetometer such as the MPMS3.

magnetometer.does: Sets temperature and field and measures the moment.

experiments.title: Magneto-optical Kerr effect
experiments.summary: The polarization of reflected light rotates in proportion to the magnetization: hysteresis loops, coercive fields and ordering temperatures of thin films and flakes.

laser.does: A stable CW laser, intensity modulated for lock-in detection.

modulation.does: Modulates the laser, or the polarization with a photoelastic modulator.

lockin.does: Reads the balanced detector's difference signal.

plans: Hysteresis loop over ±1 T

experiments.title: Scanning photocurrent microscopy
experiments.summary: Modulate the laser, raster it over a device and read the photocurrent with a lock-in: where light is turned into current (contacts, junctions, edges), and by which mechanism (photovoltaic, photothermoelectric, bolometric), against gate voltage.

laser.does: A modulated CW laser focused on the device.

modulation.does: Modulates the laser (or chops the beam) and gives the lock-in its reference.

lockin.does: Reads the photocurrent at the modulation frequency.

iamp.does: Converts the photocurrent to a voltage.

plans: Photocurrent map over 40 µm
Gate dependence at a fixed spot

experiments.title: Photoluminescence spectroscopy
experiments.summary: Excite with a laser above the gap and record the emission spectrum: excitons, trions, defects and their dependence on excitation power and temperature.

camera.does: Records the spectrum on a cooled CCD.

power_meter.does: Measures the excitation power on a pick-off.

plans: Power series from 0.1 mW to 10 mW
Temperature series at 1 mW

experiments.title: Hyperspectral PL and Raman mapping
experiments.summary: Raster the sample under the focused laser and record a spectrum at every point: maps of emission energy, intensity and linewidth, strain and doping across a flake or a device.

scanner.does: Moves the sample (or the beam) in x and y.

experiments.title: Raman spectroscopy

camera.does: Records the spectrum on a cooled CCD.

polarizer.does: Rotates a half-wave plate for polarization-resolved spectra.

experiments.summary: Map the current (or dI/dV) through a quantum dot against bias and gate voltage: charging energy, lever arm, excited states and Kondo resonances, in gate-defined dots, nanowires, nanotubes and small islands.

bias.does: Sets the source-drain bias through a divider.

iamp.does: Reads the drain current at a virtual ground.

dmm.does: Reads the DC current from the preamplifier's output.

experiments.summary: Source a voltage and measure the current to see whether contacts are ohmic, find leakage and breakdown, and characterize diodes, junctions and other nonlinear devices. The first check on any new device.

experiments.summary: Map the resistance against gate voltage and field: Landau levels, the quantum Hall effect, Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations, effective mass and quantum lifetime.

lockin_xx.does: Drives the current and reads Rxx.

experiments.summary: Drive an AC current at ω and read the transverse voltage at 2ω: the second-order (nonlinear) Hall response from a Berry curvature dipole, skew scattering or magnetic order. The same lock-in method measures harmonic Hall signals of spin-orbit torque.

lockin_2w.does: Reads the transverse voltage at 2ω, locked to the drive.

experiments.summary: Four-probe resistance with a lock-in from room temperature to base: metal or insulator, phase transitions (charge density waves, magnetic order, superconductivity) and the residual resistance ratio.

experiments.title: Pump-probe transient reflectivity
experiments.summary: A pump pulse excites the sample and a delayed probe pulse reads the change in reflectivity: carrier cooling and recombination, coherent phonons, and the recovery of ordered phases on femtosecond to nanosecond timescales.

laser.does: Femtosecond pulses, split into pump and probe (often with an OPA or harmonic for the pump).

delay.does: A linear stage that sets the pump-probe delay (6.67 fs per µm of travel in a double pass).

chopper.does: Chops the pump at a sub-harmonic of the repetition rate.

experiments.summary: Focus femtosecond pulses on the sample and record the second harmonic while the light's polarization (or the scattering plane) rotates. The patterns fit the χ(2) tensor and reveal the point-group symmetry, and how it breaks at structural, electronic or magnetic transitions.

polarization.does: Rotates the incident polarization and the analyzer (half-wave plates or polarizers on rotation mounts).

detector.does: Counts the SHG photons through a short-pass and band-pass filter, or reads a PMT with a chopper and lock-in.

chopper.does: Chops the beam for lock-in detection.

cryostat.does: Holds the temperature across a transition.
